Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 25

“The seers whose faults are worn away, whose doubts are cut, who are self-controlled and delight in the welfare of all beings, attain the peace of Brahman.”

The last item is easy to miss and hardest to fake. Krishna slips active care for every being into a list of contemplative attainments, refusing to let peace be private.
